description: PostgreSQL 18 UUID accepted input forms, canonical output, assignment validation, defaults, updates, uniqueness, indexing, and invalid input
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_uuid (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, external_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, optional_id UUID, defaulted_id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT '{D0EEBC99-9C0B-4EF8-BB6D-6BB9BD380A44}');
SELECT id, external_id, optional_id, defaulted_id FROM type_matrix_uuid;

SELECT '{a0eebc99-9c0b-4ef8-bb6d-6bb9bd380a11}'::uuid AS braced, 'a0eebc999c0b4ef8bb6d6bb9bd380a11'::uuid AS simple, 'c0ee-bc99-9c0b-4ef8-bb6d-6bb9-bd38-0a33'::uuid AS grouped, 'A0EEBC99-9C0B-4EF8-BB6D-6BB9BD380A11'::uuid AS uppercase;
UPDATE type_matrix_uuid SET optional_id = 'c0ee-bc99-9c0b-4ef8-bb6d-6bb9-bd38-0a33' WHERE id = '{a0eebc99-9c0b-4ef8-bb6d-6bb9bd380a11}'::uuid;
SELECT id, optional_id FROM type_matrix_uuid WHERE optional_id = '{c0eebc99-9c0b-4ef8-bb6d-6bb9bd380a33}'::uuid;
